title: 第2614章 天域上人的试探第2613章 吞噬拓跋云苍
slug: 我装了三年废物出手人间无敌
content_zh:
嗡！
一股强大的吞噬之力，瞬间将灰袍老者笼罩。
灰袍老者身体一颤，随后便被一股无形力量禁锢在原地。
下一刻，他体内的星力开始不受控制地涌出，朝着楚云的手掌汇聚而去。
“啊！”
体内星力被强行抽走，灰袍老者面部扭曲，发出痛苦的惨叫。
他拼命催动星力，想要挣脱吞噬之力。
但是不管他如何挣扎，都没有任何作用。
仅仅片刻，他的身体便以肉眼可见的速度干瘪下去。
天域上人见状，脸上的激动之色更加浓郁。
“像，太像了！”
“这效果跟传说中的描述几乎一模一样！”
听到“传说中”
三个字，楚云顿时松了一口气。
原本他还担心，天域上人见别人施展过鸿蒙噬天经。
如果对方亲眼见过，那么不管他怎么狡辩，恐怕都会被对方认出来。
可是现在看来，对方连鸿蒙噬天经的真实效果都不清楚。
既然如此，只要他不承认，对方就无法判断他修炼的究竟是不是鸿蒙噬天经。
随着吞天诀不断运转，灰袍老者体内的星力很快便被吞噬干净。
当体内的星力消失后，他身上的生机也开始快速流逝。

楚云见状，立刻停止运转吞天诀。
失去吞噬之力的束缚，灰袍老者身体一软，直接瘫倒在地。
天域上人一脸不解地看着楚云。
“你怎么停下来了？”
楚云道：“他体内的星力，已经被晚辈全部吸收。”
“要是继续吞噬下去，他就会死。”
天域上人闻言，看了一眼瘫倒在地的灰袍老者，随后深吸一口气。
“把他带下去。”
金云霄点头道：“是。”
说完，他伸手抓住灰袍老者的手臂，如同拖死尸一般，将对方拖出大殿。
待到两人离开，天域上人看着楚云问道：“你这部星法是从哪里得到的？”
楚云拱手道：“不瞒宫主，晚辈来自下界位面。”
“这部星法，是一名前辈传授给晚辈的。”
天域上人目光一凝。
“那他传授你这部星法时，你有没有在他身上看见一面镜子？”
楚云摇头道：“没有。”
天域上人盯着楚云的眼睛，一字一句道：“一面古朴的青色铜镜，你真没有见过？”
楚云神情平静，再次摇头。
“没有。”
content_en:
Buzz!
A powerful devouring force instantly enveloped the gray-robed old man.
The gray-robed old man's body trembled, and then he was imprisoned in place by an invisible force.
The next moment, the star power in his body began to flow out uncontrollably, converging towards Chu Yun's palm.
"Ah!"
The star power in his body was forcibly taken away, and the gray-robed old man's face twisted and he screamed in pain.
He desperately mobilized his star power, trying to break free from the devouring power.
But no matter how hard he struggled, it had no effect.
In just a moment, his body shriveled up at a speed visible to the naked eye.
When Master Tianyu saw this, the excitement on his face became even more intense.
"Like, so similar!"
"This effect is almost exactly the same as the description in the legend!"
Hear "legend"
With these three words, Chu Yun suddenly breathed a sigh of relief.
Originally, he was worried that Master Tianyu had seen someone else perform the Hongmeng Heaven-Eating Sutra.
If the other party has seen it with his own eyes, then no matter how he quibbles, he will probably be recognized by the other party.
But now it seems that the other party doesn't even know the true effect of Hongmeng Heaven-Eating Scripture.
In this case, as long as he does not admit it, the other party will not be able to judge whether he is practicing the Hongmeng Heaven-Eating Sutra.
As the Heaven-Swallowing Technique continued to operate, the star power in the gray-robed old man's body was quickly swallowed up.
When the star power in his body disappeared, the vitality in his body also began to drain quickly.
When Chu Yun saw this, he immediately stopped operating the Heaven Swallowing Technique.
Losing the restraint of the devouring power, the gray-robed old man's body softened and he collapsed directly to the ground.
Master Tianyu looked at Chu Yun with a puzzled expression.
"Why did you stop?"
Chu Yun said: "The star power in his body has been absorbed by this junior."
"If he continues to swallow it, he will die."
Upon hearing this, Master Tianyu glanced at the old man in gray robe who collapsed on the ground, and then took a deep breath.
"Take him down."
Jin Yunxiao nodded: "Yes."
After saying that, he reached out and grabbed the arm of the old man in gray robe, dragging him out of the hall like a dead body.
After the two left, Master Tianyu looked at Chu Yun and asked, "Where did you get this star method?"
Chu Yun cupped his hands and said, "To be fair to the palace master, this junior comes from the lower realm."
"This star method was taught by a senior to a junior."
Master Tianyu’s eyes narrowed.
"Then when he taught you this star method, did you see a mirror in him?"
Chu Yun shook his head and said, "No."
Master Tianyu stared at Chu Yun's eyes and said word by word: "A simple blue bronze mirror, have you really never seen it?"
Chu Yun looked calm and shook his head again.
"No."
